content_mode_evidence: Observed sample only. All 3 reels whose covers the project coded are rated ai_generated: DXSJiT9kTKh ('warped crystal chandelier geometry, garbled ornament on range hood, melting reflections'), Db3zHF5setq ('impossibly perfect symmetry, sparkle-dotted ceiling, smeared railing and chandelier details; reposted from creator watermark' ZA zaxzaaafrica) and DXrG2Evjn78 ('over-smooth puffy curved sofa, mushy tray objects', cover 'LUX LIVING theluxliving_official'). None of the captions discloses AI. The 4th topic reel (DF1kNfqRmIF, a dream closet via @msblingmiami) and the recent Threads reposts (via @island.realtor, @ellys.spaces, @valentina__ortu, luxuriatehomes) were not visually coded. The account is 8,694 posts deep, so it may also carry real-photo content; that is unverified, so the observed mode is recorded as AI.
niche_focus: Curated reposts, credited 'via @creator', of glam/classical luxury home interiors (cream-and-gold living rooms, kitchens, closets, grand halls). Monetized with home-decor brand discount codes, an Amazon storefront and virtual design consults.
cta_pattern: Bio: 'DM for virtual consults or collabs!' (service plus brand-contact CTA), with a Linktree of affiliate storefronts and discount codes. Captions are short engagement hooks plus a credit: 'What do you think of this kitchen design? Via @deirdres_design', 'Tag someone who would love this dream closet via @msblingmiami ✨ I'm excited to offer a special virtual design consultation!', 'Soft neutrals, grand scale, and endless elegance. Save this for your dream home inspo ✨Via @zaxzaaafrica', 'Yes or no? Via @ellys.spaces' (Threads). The pattern is question / tag / save hook, then 'via @source', with occasional service plugs.

notes: COVERAGE LIMITED. The WebSearch budget (200/200) was used up, so the step 1, 3 and 4 searches were not run and there are no Instagram snippets, no paid-partnership search and no search-based reel sample. Profile data comes from Threads (public; 195.5K Threads followers and 411 threads, THREADS counts only, not Instagram) and from the public Linktree. Linktree details from its public page JSON: account created 2021-07-08, tier 'pro', verticals ['influencer', 'fashion-beauty', 'ecommerce']. It also has a header group 'Jesus gave his life for our sins'. The Linktree email address is a personal-name address, so it is deliberately not copied here; it is visible at the URL. The Amazon storefront and deirdresdesign.com could not be read (HTTP 503 and a captcha respectively). Both brand-code links (Hulala Home DED15, Z Gallerie DED5) carry utm_medium=kol and utm_campaign=Instagram_kol_deirdres_design, which fits brand creator (KOL) programs. Whether these are paid flat-fee deals or commission-only is UNKNOWN. Reel data from the public topic pages and embeds (rounded): DF1kNfqRmIF 71.7K views (2025-02-09); DXrG2Evjn78 30.2K views, 1,248 likes, 17 comments (2026-04-28); Db3zHF5setq 23.1K views, 705 likes, 10 comments (2026-08-10); DXSJiT9kTKh 21.9K views, 608 likes, 20 comments (2026-04-18). Views per follower are low (about 0.02 to 0.07 on 1M followers), typical of a large, older repost page. Recent Threads posts (2026-09) are all reposts with 'via @' credits: @island.realtor, @ellys.spaces, @valentina__ortu, luxuriatehomes. Classification note: the bio says she is a real interior decorator, but the feed seen is curation of other creators' (largely AI) designs. So account_type is theme_page, with designer_studio as a secondary role (virtual consults). No income estimate was seen or made.
